ES Start your Sprint

Seven days to say your first sentences in English.

A set plan, twenty minutes a day and Mei by your side. No endless theory: every day you say something new out loud.

See places and priceMeet Mei

This is how Day 1 starts

Today you talk about yourself. Your name, where you're from, what you do, what you like. These are the sentences you'll use in every conversation of your life.

Hi, I'm Ana.Hola, soy Ana.
I'm from Lima, in Peru.Soy de Lima, en Perú.
I'm a nurse.Soy enfermera.
I work in a hospital.Trabajo en un hospital.

Then: tasks that tick themselves, the typical mistake of the day, a real challenge and your reflection. Seven days like that.

Your Sprint

    The Sprint tasks

    Six tasks a day. They tick themselves when you finish each room.

    Sprint progress

    Your before and after

    Read the Sprint card out loud on Day 1, and again on Day 7. The same five sentences, seven days apart. Recordings stay on this device until you send them.

    Hi, I'm ____. I'm from ____.
    I speak Spanish, and I'm studying English.
    I live in a big city, and I really like it.
    Yesterday I worked, and then I watched a film.
    I think this is a very good start.

    Day 7: your 2-minute talk

    Four parts, thirty seconds each: who you are, what you like, what you did last week, and why you are learning English. No script. Keep going until the clock stops.
